oneOf.description: 3D Manufacturing Format for representing 3D objects with materials and geometry.
Autodesk FBX format supporting meshes, skeletal animation, and production pipelines.
GL Transmission Format optimized for efficient transmission and rendering of 3D scenes.
Binary version of glTF packaging geometry, textures, and animation in a single file, widely used for real-time avatars.
Avatar-specific format based on glTF designed for humanoid characters, including metadata, rigging, and facial expressions.
Wavefront OBJ format representing static geometry with optional materials.
Polygon File Format storing geometry and associated properties such as color and normals.
Stereolithography format representing triangulated surfaces, commonly used in 3D printing.
Universal Scene Description format enabling complex scene composition, animation, and interchange.
Compressed, package-based version of USD optimized for real-time rendering and AR applications (e.g., mobile avatars).
